purpose: Dofetilide is used to treat an irregular heartbeat called atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter. It helps restore your heart back to a normal, steady rhythm and keeps it there. Your doctor may prescribe this when other treatments have not worked well enough.
how_it_works: Your heart beats regularly because of electrical signals that travel through it in an organized way. In atrial fibrillation, those signals become chaotic and disorganized. Dofetilide works by slowing down certain electrical signals in the heart, helping it reset and maintain a normal, steady rhythm.
common_side_effects: Headache, dizziness, chest pain, shortness of breath, and mild nausea are the most commonly reported side effects. Some people may also notice swelling in their legs or feet or feel unusually tired.
warnings: This is a very serious medication that can actually cause a dangerous irregular heartbeat in some people, especially when first starting it. Because of this risk, you MUST be started on this medication in a hospital where your heart can be closely monitored for at least 3 days. Many common medications and even some foods or supplements can dangerously interact with dofetilide, so always tell every doctor and pharmacist you take it. Never stop taking it or change your dose without talking to your doctor first.
typical_dosing: The dose is usually taken twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening. Your exact dose depends on how well your kidneys are working, so your doctor will check your kidney function and adjust the dose specifically for you. Always take it exactly as prescribed.
